verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the exact flow: log in to Transform, upload a document, parse it, optionally extract structured data, then use 'Get Code' to build an integration. That means a developer can see parse and extract results in the UI before writing code. The no-code Pipelines workflow designer reinforces that a UI-first path exists. Missing for 10: explicit drag-and-drop interaction, documentation of how results are displayed or inspected in the playground, independent or hands-on corroboration.
